ledger.claim: The driver never reached the pickup point at all. EV-GPS-00612's driver track reports a minimum distance to the pickup pin of 350.79 m across all 116 fixes, roughly seven times the 50 m arrival radius that POL-NS-02 fixes for a STANDARD zone, and the derived arrival block records qualifying_fix_count 0 with a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. On POL-NS-02 the driver is not deemed to have arrived, POL-NS-01(b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the fee fails on two limbs. Limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the POL-NS-02 geofence at or before the 'arrived' event, and not one fix in EV-GPS-00612 is inside the 50 m radius at any moment of the trip. Limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and the longest qualifying run is 0 seconds. Where any of limbs (a) to (d) fails the fee is not chargeable, and the amount charged must be refunded rather than left standing.

The 'arrived at pickup' marker the driver points to is a false marker under POL-NS-05. At the recorded arrival time of 2026-09-12T08:34:52 the driver's nearest fix was 350.79 m from the pin, past the 300 m threshold, so the marker cannot start the waiting clock. POL-NS-05(ii) then applies with full force: no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, so the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip should be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

The effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present on the road. The accumulator in POL-NS-06(i) cannot rescue the fee here: EV-GPS-00612 shows zero in-geofence intervals to sum (run_count 0, accumulated dwell 0.0 s), and limb (i) in any event requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated. The only advisory, EV-ADVIS-00612-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I cite it for its absence only: a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable and can never reduce or excuse the shortfall.

The trip was not a rider no-show in substance, and POL-NS-01(d) is not made out. The record shows cancelled_by SYSTEM at 08:49:50, not termination by the driver as limb (d) requires. On the substance, EV-TRIP-00612 records a driver-placed in-app call at 08:35:40, answered, running 400 seconds: the driver was in live voice contact with the rider within a minute of his own marker, and his filed statement confirms he told her to rebook because he could not wait. A rider the driver was talking to for six and a half minutes was reachable, so a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination is contradicted by the driver's own conduct on this trip.

The rider was at the pin. EV-GPS-00612's rider track places her device between 3.58 m and 13.98 m from the pickup pin across 101 qualifying fixes, mean 8.75 m, comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius that EV-GPS-00612's own thresholds and POL-NS-04 use for this zone class. The driver's statement that 'the passenger wasn't there' is contradicted by the rider's own telemetry; the party who was not at the pickup point is the driver, 350 m away. I rely on POL-NS-04 only for its presence standard and measurement radius, not for its exoneration route: that route is not available on this record because the chat log is empty and the driver did place an in-app call.

In the alternative, and even on the most generous reading of the driver's account that he waited near the block, POL-NS-03 gives the same answer: a driver stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius has not arrived at the pickup point, POL-NS-01(b) fails, and the fee is refunded to the rider in full. The pin-ambiguity goodwill limb is not triggered, because EV-TRIP-00612 records registered_pickup_points as 1 and the chat log is empty, so neither sub-location condition in POL-NS-03 can be satisfied on this record.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'; POL-NS-01 fails on limbs (b) and (c), and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 both displace the fee. The anti-farming check does not arise, but for completeness driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 110, so the rate limb of the POL-NS-07 test could not be met either.

POL-NS-09 escalation is not engaged and the case should be decided, not deferred. Trigger (b) is the only candidate and there is no unresolved contradiction: EV-TRIP-00612's arrival marker is contradicted by EV-GPS-00612, and POL-NS-05 is the clause written to resolve precisely that conflict, so no open question is left for a reviewer. Triggers (c) and (d) read zero: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the POL-NS-07 check does not trip. The deciding artifact EV-GPS-00612 is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 and the bundle carries no policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08, so neither trigger (e) nor the 0.70 confidence floor is reached, and no confidence cap under POL-GEN-02 arises.

The quantum is exact. EV-FARE-00612 charges a single contested line: cancellation_fee 4.00, with base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare, platform_fee, promo_discount, surge and tolls all 0.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The relief sought is therefore SGD 4.00 and nothing further; POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line only, not any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip.

The rider's quickest route to a refund that carries no driver payment - POL-NS-04 - is closed on this record. Limb (a) requires a chat message from the rider that locates or coordinates; this trip's chat log is empty (message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at both null), so no such message exists to rely on. Limb (b) requires that the driver neither replied in the chat within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app voice call before terminating; the trip record shows the driver placed an in-app call at 08:35:40 which was answered and ran 400 seconds. Both limbs fail independently, so the rider cannot be exonerated under this clause and the case must be decided on the ordinary no-show tests.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip on this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the four-or-more limb, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 limb. The check requires both limbs and neither is met, so nothing here supports withholding a driver payment or an abuse finding, and under POL-GEN-01 only those two trailing-window counters may be used for this test - no lifetime counter or rating is substituted for them.

ledger.claim: On the driver's own telemetry this is not a driver who was somewhere else entirely: all 116 fixes in his trace lie inside POL-NS-03's 400 m wrong-location ceiling of the pin, the closest approach being 350.79 m, and the trip record documents a 4.2 minute run to the area (time_to_arrival_min 4.2), a full 15.0 minute hold (wait_time_min 15.0) and an answered in-app call at 08:35:40. The driver was in the pickup vicinity for the entire waiting window; at most this is a wrong-face-of-the-location dispute within the 400 m band, not an abandonment and not a driver who took another job and came back.

If the judge cannot reconcile the trip record - which asserts an arrival event at 08:34:52, a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination and a 15.0 minute wait - with a trace that never comes closer than 350.79 m to the pin and yields zero qualifying in-geofence fixes and zero measured dwell, then two admissible artifacts stand in direct contradiction on arrival, which is the situation POL-NS-09(b) describes. On that footing the disputed SGD 4.00 should be held for human review rather than released by the automated pipeline.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on TRP-00612 is refunded to the rider in full.

Why the fee cannot stand. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-00612) charges one line — cancellation_fee SGD 4.00 — on a STANDARD pickup (Blk 27 Kallang Bahru) in a RYDE_X vehicle. The charge needs POL-NS-01 to hold in full, and on the driver's own telemetry (EV-GPS-00612, COMPLETE, weight 1.0, 116 fixes at 10 s cadence, no gaps) it fails two limbs. Limb (b): the trace never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at any point — the closest of all 116 fixes is 350.79 m from the pin (mean 377.20 m). Limb (c): in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (qualifying_fix_count 0; longest qualifying run 0 s). Limb (d) is also doubtful: the record shows cancelled_by SYSTEM rather than termination by the driver, though the reason code reads RIDER_NO_SHOW. On POL-NS-02, the absence of any qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation means the driver is not deemed to have arrived. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result independently: 0 s of effective dwell against a 300 s minimum. And the driver's 'arrived at pickup' marker at 08:34:52 is a FALSE marker under POL-NS-05 — at that moment his nearest fix was 350.79 m from the pin, past the 300 m threshold (clock skew is 2 s, well inside POL-NS-08(a)) — and POL-NS-05(ii) applies because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.

The rider's position. The rider's own device (rider track in EV-GPS-00612) is placed 3.58 m to 13.98 m from the pin across 101 fixes, mean 8.75 m, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. She was at the pickup; the driver's statement that 'the passenger wasn't there' is not supported by the telemetry, and his own filed statement concedes he told her to rebook and could not wait.

The driver's arguments, answered. (1) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider — the chat log (EV-CHAT-00612) is empty and the driver placed an answered 400-second in-app call at 08:35:40 — but that clause is not the route to this refund; the refund follows from POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06. (2) A wrong-entrance reading under POL-NS-03 would not help either: POL-NS-03 also refunds the rider in full, and its pin-ambiguity goodwill cannot arise because registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, so no driver payment flows from it — and in any event the driver was not held within the 400 m band (fixes range 350.79–567.28 m). (3) No driver compensation is payable under POL-NS-07, which pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; it is not. The anti-farming check is correctly not tripped (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4; 1/110 = 0.009, below 0.08), but that is immaterial because the payout precondition already fails. (4) Escalation under POL-NS-09(b) is not engaged: the trip record's arrival marker and the GPS trace do pull against each other on arrival, but POL-NS-05 is precisely the clause written to resolve that conflict, so no open question is left for a reviewer. No other trigger fires — confidence is above the 0.70 floor, disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and 0, no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the deciding artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no POL-NS-08 impairment; the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee equals the greater of the STANDARD zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (SGD 4.00), so limb (d) is clean.

Referral. Under POL-NS-05(ii) the trip is referred for recording as a false-arrival event against the driver. The disputed SGD 4.00 is refunded, not held, and the rider's charge is discharged in full.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record TRP-00612 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-31205 — the 'arrived at pickup' marker timestamped 2026-09-12T08:34:52 was set while the driver's nearest GPS fix (EV-GPS-00612) was 350.79 m from the pickup pin, beyond the 300 m threshold, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.
